title: The entry into relationships and the karmic tail — point M

seo.title: Point M in the destiny matrix — the entry and the tail
seo.description: Point M in the destiny matrix: how the southern inner point is worked out, why the relationship line and the karmic tail both start there.
queries: point m in the destiny matrix
southern point of the destiny matrix
entry to the relationship line destiny matrix

meaning: Point M stands between the karmic task D and the centre of the chart E, and it is their sum. It shows the first reaction at the moment a situation becomes genuinely personal. One person moves straight towards closeness, another checks whether it is safe, a third hides behind control or a joke. The end of the story is not in this point, but its emotional start is easy to see.

Two different routes run out of M. In relationships it is M→R1→R: the way into closeness, the partner point and the way of building a union. In the karmic tail it is M→N→D: the first impulse, its lesson and the way out to the karmic task. So the same arcanum does not get one universal reading — the context of the line changes the question.

M has one feature you notice at once on your own chart: the numbers here are always multiples of three. There are only seven possible values — 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21. That is how the formula works, and no other number can stand in this place for any date of birth. If a reading names, say, a ten here, it is talking about the neighbouring point of the relationship line, not about the entry.

A strong side of M is catching your first impulse before it has turned into a familiar script. For example, not declaring a partner’s silence to be rejection, and not answering a new situation with an old defence. A weak side is treating the automatic reaction as the only one possible and being surprised by the same ending every time. A useful way to read the point is to compare your last two episodes of closeness with two conflicts that keep repeating: where the reaction was the same, while the meaning and what followed turned out different.
